notes:
Track a single flight now follows it from takeoff to landing, anywhere, by callsign, registration, or hex instead of radius.
New flight screens: airline logo, route progress, local times, flight phase, and a route map on the dashboard.
Flight-number check (AS555 becomes ASA555); optional Flystack key for timetable and gates.
Airframes shown by name, e.g. Boeing 737 MAX 9.
